name: PBA
recent: PBA 股东在 2026 年 11 月 12 日的特别股东大会上以 97.94% 的赞成票通过了从 Perak 购买净水的提案。此前公司就 Northern Perak Water Supply Scheme 下的批量净水采购提交了股东通函，并多次申请延长提交期限。公司近期也出现多项 Chapter 10 非关联方交易公告及重大诉讼公告。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会上以 97.94% 赞成票通过从 Perak 购买净水的提案。
公司就 Northern Perak Water Supply Scheme 下的批量净水采购向 Bursa Securities 提交股东通函草稿。
公司出现多项 Chapter 10 非关联方交易公告。
risks: 批量净水采购的股东通函提交曾多次获 Bursa Securities 延长时限。

events.what_en: Record of Depositors date for EGM

recent_en: PBA shareholders approved the proposed bulk treated water purchase from Perak with 97.94% support at an EGM on 12 November 2026. The company had submitted the shareholder circular for the bulk water purchase under the Northern Perak Water Supply Scheme and sought several extensions of time for its submission. There were also several Chapter 10 non-related party transaction announcements and material litigation announcements.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the proposed bulk treated water purchase from Perak with 97.94% support at an EGM.
The company submitted the draft shareholder circular for the proposed bulk water purchase under the Northern Perak Water Supply Scheme to Bursa Securities.
The company made several Chapter 10 non-related party transaction announcements.
risks_en: The company has material litigation announcements.
The submission of the shareholder circular for the proposed bulk water purchase was granted several extensions of time by Bursa Securities.
